Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE game background sprite ATLAS, 3 columns by 3 rows of EXACTLY NINE equal panoramic cells, edge-to-edge aligned, NO gutters, NO borders, NO labels. Entire image 3:1 landscape, preferably 2304x768 pixels; each cell is a separate 3:1 landscape scene. This is a production asset to slice by exact grid coordinates, not a UI or a poster.
Primary request: NINE distinct football stadium upgrade stages in 1950–1969 Europe, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Every tile uses the same low near-touchline three-quarter camera, shows the green pitch across the lower third and clearly reveals the grandstands beyond, with empty seats. Nine progressively larger grounds:
row1 left: tiny 2500-capacity village ground, timber rail and low earth terrace, small brick hut; middle: 5000 ground, one modest timber covered stand, low opposite terrace; right: newly built 10000 ground, two brick/concrete terraces, narrow steel roof.
row2 left: 15000 ground, longer concrete stands on both sides; middle: 30000 grand ground, broad concrete stand with a large corrugated roof; right: 40000, a clear two-tier stand opposite.
row3 left: 60000, large two-tier stadium with several stands; middle: 75000, corners filled with terracing; right: 90000, imposing continuous concrete bowl and sweeping vintage steel roofs, a grand 1950s European national-scale venue.
Style: unmistakable COARSE 16-bit pixel art, like original classic PC football game background sprites; flat chunky square pixel clusters, sharp stair-step silhouettes, limited 20–28-colour palette, minimal dither, no smooth painterly texture. Each scene has a logical pixel grid about 192x64 enlarged crisply. Keep the grid visibly coarse even in tiny scenes, highly legible architecture and deliberate shapes rather than noisy texture.
Shared colours: charcoal #111415, dark pine #18261e, muted grass #2e713d/#4b9656, moss #6c8255, cream #d8d0b5, aged brown wood #65513c and tiny amber lamps #b99864. Quiet evening, deep blue-grey sky, ordinary early floodlights; controlled midtones and no spectacular glowing light. Dark low-contrast atmosphere to sit behind game data.
Period: 1950s/1960s brick, timber, concrete, riveted steel roof trusses, simple terracing and ordinary floodlight poles. No contemporary plastic seating, glass curtain walls, giant video screens, LED ribbons, futuristic roofs, cars or advertising.
Constraints: All nine cells must be genuinely different scenes with visible progression, never repeated recolours. Same consistent game art direction. No people, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, diagrams, UI, split-screen captions or labels.
